registerPage.title: Join as a Beta Tester

featured-1.name: The Sims 4: Horse Ranch
featured-1.description: Craft your own rustic life. Raise and train horses, bond with mini-goats and mini-sheep, and brew your own homemade nectar to sell or share.

pack-1.name: The Sims 4: Discover University
pack-1.description: Enroll in university, explore academic experiences, and attend extracurricular activities.

pack-2.name: The Sims 4: City Living
pack-2.description: Take your Sims to the big city and experience everything it offers, from noisy street life to unique apartment living.

pack-3.name: The Sims 4: Seasons
pack-3.description: Add weather to your Sims' lives to tell new stories, enjoy seasonal activities, and celebrate holidays.

pack-4.name: The Sims 4: Get to Work!
pack-4.description: Actively control your Sims in their workplaces and determine whether they head towards a big promotion or become a menace.

pack-5.name: The Sims 4: Cats & Dogs
pack-5.description: Create a variety of dogs and cats, add them to your Sims' homes to change their lives forever, and care for neighborhood pets.

pack-6.name: The Sims 4: Island Living
pack-6.description: Escape routine and enjoy a laid-back lifestyle surrounded by beaches in Sulani, where the sun shines bright and nights are cool.

pack-7.name: The Sims 4: Snowy Escape
pack-7.description: Gear up for winter sports, relax in hot springs, and design your Japanese-style home.

pack-8.name: The Sims 4: For Rent
pack-8.description: Experience multi-family neighborhood life as a tenant or owner of residential rental properties.
